rows.24:9b48: Went to the old school building restroom from earlier
rows.24:a630:
Takeuchi had been tricked.
The plant had told him, apparently, that by absorbing his waste it would take on his exact shape, until in the end it couldn't be told apart from a human.
Takeuchi wanted to make a clone of himself.
I guess he wanted to do sci-fi stuff, like the two of them taking turns going to class or going out to have fun.
That's why he'd been dutifully making trips there.
But the idea that it could make a clone was a lie.
The plant's real goal was to make a human into its food...
I just ran out of there.
There was no way I had the power to save Takeuchi.
And I swore I'd never go there again.
Even after I got out of the restroom and was running down the hallway, I could hear Takeuchi screaming.
He cried out again and again, in agony.
I can still hear it now.
Takeuchi's screams.
His voice calling for help...
...
I've told you everything I saw.
Now, shall we move on to the next story...{p}
rows.24:acc4:
When I looked inside, the plant...
The plant with Takeuchi's face was crying.
The Takeuchi in human form wasn't there anymore.
And the plant was saying something like this:
"Help me...!
I'm Takeuchi.
An evil spirit turned me into this.
Help me... please... help me..."
He told me the whole story.
On the first day Takeuchi came to this school, he snuck into the old school building as a prank.
While he was there, he needed to use the restroom...
When he used that toilet, an evil spirit's hand came out of the bowl and grabbed his leg, it seems.
The evil spirit sucked the life energy out of Takeuchi's body.
And Takeuchi was turned into a plant, he said.
After that, the evil spirit took on Takeuchi's exact form...
And started coming to school in his place, he told me.
Every so often, the evil spirit would come to Takeuchi and suck out his life energy.
It drained the energy out of Takeuchi, that shriveled-up plant, like it was wringing him dry.
I guess evil spirits don't relieve themselves at all.
That's why Takeuchi got the reputation of never going to the restroom.
I bet nobody knew he'd been making trips to the old school building's restroom.
Takeuchi, now a plant, was wailing.
But there was nothing I could do.
I apologized to him over and over, and left the old school building's restroom behind...{p}
rows.24:c258:
It was a murky, pitch-black color.
It had a grassy smell, like bitter medicinal herbs.
"It has an unusual taste, so people either love it or hate it, but once you get used to it, it's irresistible.
Go on, try it."
...What would you do in a moment like this?{p}
rows.24:d1b8:
"{a}{f:|}, I'm sorry.
I couldn't let you taste the Sanbura tea.
Next time, I'll make it properly and bring it in.
Then you won't have to go to the restroom either..."
Every time Hosoda spoke, the grassy smell stung {f:my|my} nose.
{f:No way|No way}.
There's no way {f:I could|I'd ever} drink something that creepy.
Time to have him wrap up his story, so we can hurry on to the next one...{p}
rows.24:d340:
Something pricked my foot.
What was that...?{p}
rows.24:e0e4:
I was a little relieved.
Why, you ask?
In my mind, Takeuchi was a superman who never went to the restroom, or a hero, or something...
Anyway, I'd finally gotten close to someone like that, so finding out he was just an ordinary person would have been a letdown.
I guess I didn't want my image of the 'amazing person' right beside me to be shattered.
So I followed Takeuchi into the old school building.{p}
rows.24:f1dc:
With that, he thrust the flowerpot toward me, looking really, really happy.
In the flowerpot, that flower was writhing and squirming, hungry for prey.
I was scared, but I wanted to taste the pleasure Takeuchi talked about.
I took the plunge and held out my right arm.{p}
rows.24:10fb0:
I decided to accept Takeuchi's kindness at face value.
Takeuchi asked me to come with him behind the old school building, and we walked there together.{p}
rows.24:11a50:
Inside the swollen part, lots of soft-looking red berries were lined up.
They were a slightly translucent red, about the size of salmon roe.
They were crammed in, with no room to spare.
Do you know 'sujiko'?
It looked like it was stuffed full of that.
Takeuchi bit into it, devouring it greedily.
Squish, squish... I could hear the berries bursting.
The way he ate was really abnormal; he was like a different person from the Takeuchi of a moment ago.
When he'd finished eating, Takeuchi turned to face me.
For a second, my blood ran cold.{p}
